comment: 2026-10-28: the release-train controller that settled a STOP was retired 2026-10-27, so release_control_cli.py resume
refused STOP_NOT_SETTLED after every stop. resume(settle_if_idle=True) settles as the verified operator only while it
holds the GlobalReleaseLock the deploy_on_main poller holds for a whole deploy; a held lock keeps the refusal.
